figures.finding: The British Indian Ocean Territory levies no income tax: its Taxation Ordinance bars any law in the Territory from imposing income, corporation or capital gains tax or any similar tax on income, wherever it arises.

sources.said: An Ordinance to discontinue the application in the British Indian Ocean Territory of laws providing for the imposition of taxes and certain duties. … 3. No law having effect in the Territory pursuant to Section 3(2)(a) of the British Indian Ocean Territory (Constitution) Order 2004 shall have effect so as to require or permit the imposition within the Territory of any income tax, corporation tax, capital gains tax or any substantially similar tax upon income, profits, gains and capital whether arising within the Territory or outside it.

figures.finding: No income tax is imposed in the Territory on anyone, so a visiting performer, writer or director pays none there.

figures.finding: The Territory levies no social security contribution and no sales tax or VAT: the revised ordinances hold a Taxation Ordinance and a Charges for Services Ordinance (fees for services the Administration provides) but no social insurance or sales-tax law; the Employment Ordinance instead obliges the employer to keep each employee insured against death or injury at work.
